description: This script automates testing of syncing Perforce depot history into a Git repository, cloning repositories with options to include or exclude empty commits, and verifying the correctness of the clone operation.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts a Perforce server for testing.

methods.name: client_view
methods.description: Sets up the Perforce client view mappings.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up the Git repository after tests.
